title: Bounded-time machine behavior
statement: Let $N$ be a nondeterministic Turing machine with $K$ work tapes, and let $C$ be a configuration on input $x$. For a time bound $T$ and predicates $	ext{box}$ and $Q$ on configurations, every choice string of length at most $T$ must lead to a configuration satisfying $	ext{box}$; moreover, every choice string of length exactly $T$ must lead to a halted configuration satisfying $Q$.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number $K$ of work tapes
